    Reducing the BGRS pair dichotomy to the middle-unit common-ray law #

    The exceptional branch of the BGRS pair dichotomy follows from local Artinian endomorphism rings. For the nonexceptional branch, nonvanishing of middle-unit twists follows from a split residue map detecting the Jacobson radical. The remaining source-specific datum is exactly that such twists belong to the common unit ray.
